explanation: For the requested polynomial integral, ∫_{-2}^{2}(2-x²) dx = [2x-x³/3]_{-2}^{2} = 8/3, so option d is correct. This evaluates the signed integral, not the original solid's volume.

reviewed_recovery_request.source_problem:
Find the volume of the solid $R,$ given by

$$
R={(x,y,z)\,:\,-2\le x\le 2,\,0\le z\le \sqrt{2-{x}^{2}},\,0\le y\le 2z}.
$$
reviewed_recovery_request.confidence_scope: Only the ordinary signed polynomial integral on [-2,2]. NOT the original real solid volume. The actual real x projection is [-sqrt(2),sqrt(2)], giving original volume 8sqrt(2)/3, absent from all displayed choices.
